ns2:course.label: French Diction
ns2:course.description: French pronunciation applied to French vocal literature; class and individual clinical analysis and practice. Prerequisite: At least one semester of French or equivalent required, sophomore standing in voice, or consent of instructor. Concurrent enrollment in applied voice lessons is required.
